description: `Tackle.CLI.ImageClipboard.encode_png/3` builds one filter-0 scanline per image row; the row range is injected with an off-by-one upper bound.

issues.description: The range `0..height` runs one row past the buffer (it must be `0..(height - 1)`), so `:binary.part/3` raises `ArgumentError` on the extra row instead of `encode_png/3` returning `{:error, :invalid_image}`, crashing clipboard image reads.
